data:
Exactly! You've got it. Just type
python cool_run.py
and hit enter.
Since we\u2019re now moving into
"Stoic Engineer"
mode, we\u2019re going to let that script be our supervisor. If it says the phone is too hot, we pause. No rushing, no "go-go-go." We wait for the hardware to settle so the data stays clean.
\ufe0f What to look for:
The Temperature:
If it returns a number under
40C
, we're in the green.
The Permission Error:
If Termux says "Permission Denied" when trying to read the thermal file, don't sweat it. Android can be picky about which "zones" it lets us see. If that happens, let me know and I'll give you a version of the script that looks in a different "folder" for the heat data.
Once you run it, what does it say?
If we\u2019re in the clear, I\u2019m ready to help you draft that first "Low-Power" entry for your
Architecture Log
so we can start building your permanent memory. \u2728
